Sandbox_FYDS_Visibility_tooltip:
Who sees a death skull on the world map. Has no effect in singleplayer.
Only me: only the player who died.
Me + faction: the player who died and the members of their faction.
Everyone: every player on the server.
Sandbox_FYDS_KeepCorpse_tooltip:
Your corpse, and the corpse of your zombie once it is killed, never rots and is never removed by Hours for Corpse Removal, so your gear stays where you fell. Its skull stays on the map.
Other corpses are not affected.
